d: Company Description We values integrity, respect, and professionalism, creating a supportive environment for ongoing learning and development.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Respiratory Therapist role based in Doha, Qatar. The Respiratory Therapist will assess, plan, and provide respiratory care treatments for patients with acute and chronic cardiopulmonary conditions, including ventilator management, oxygen therapy, and airway care. Daily responsibilities include performing diagnostic respiratory procedures, monitoring patient responses, updating treatment plans, and documenting care in accordance with clinical standards and regulations. The role involves collaboration with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals in areas such as intensive care and neonatal units, as well as educating patients and families on respiratory health and equipment use. The Respiratory Therapist is expected to follow infection control protocols and participate in quality improvement and continuing education activities.
q: Demonstrated knowledge and practical skills in Cardiopulmonary and Respiratory Care.
Clinical experience or training in Respiratory Therapy and Medicine relevant to acute and chronic care settings.
Competence in Neonatal Intensive Care respiratory support, including ventilator management and monitoring.
Valid Respiratory Therapist licensure or eligibility for licensure in Qatar, and graduation from an accredited Respiratory Therapy or related healthcare program.
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to patient safety and infection control.
Effective communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and educate patients and families.
Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, and to participate in ongoing professional development.
Previous hospital or critical care experience is preferred; experience in Middle East healthcare settings is an advantage.
